points.title: Get answered with AccessAckData, no error
points.condition: D beat for a clean data Get with d_opcode=1 and d_error=0

points.title: PutFullData acknowledged with AccessAck
points.condition: D beat for a clean size-2 PutFullData with d_opcode=0 and d_error=0

points.title: PutPartialData full-word write succeeds
points.condition: D beat for a clean size-2 PutPartialData with d_opcode=0 and d_error=0

points.title: Byte write to 1-bit register INTR_ENABLE0
points.condition: Accepted PutPartialData of size 0, mask 0001 to 0x100

points.title: Byte write to wide register returns error
points.condition: D beat with d_error=1 for a clean byte PutPartialData at lane 0 of a register at 0x110 to 0x11C

points.title: Get to unmapped offset accepted
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word Get to an offset in 0x120 to 0x1FC

points.title: Write to unmapped offset accepted
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to an offset in 0x120 to 0x1FC

points.title: Unmapped access answered with d_error
points.condition: D beat with d_error=1 for a clean aligned word request at an address of 0x120 or above

points.title: Illegal opcode request
points.condition: Accepted request with opcode other than 0, 1, 4

points.title: Illegal size 3 request
points.condition: Accepted request with a_size=3

points.title: Misaligned address request
points.condition: Accepted request with size 1 and odd address or size 2 and address not a multiple of 4

points.title: PutFullData with incomplete mask
points.condition: Accepted size-2 PutFullData with mask not 1111

points.title: Byte read at lane 0 of a mapped register
points.condition: Accepted clean size-0 Get at byte lane 0 of a mapped register

points.title: Byte read at lane 3 of a mapped register
points.condition: Accepted clean size-0 Get at byte lane 3 of a mapped register

points.title: Half-word read of upper half
points.condition: Accepted clean size-1 Get at address offset 2 of a mapped register

points.title: Instruction-fetch Get
points.condition: Accepted Get with i_a_instr=1

points.title: Corrupted A-channel integrity request
points.condition: Accepted request with i_a_intg_flip=1

points.title: Alert pulse without integrity fault
points.condition: o_alert high while no corrupted request was accepted since reset

points.title: Repeated alert after integrity fault
points.condition: o_alert pulse after a corrupted request and after at least one earlier pulse

points.title: ALERT_TEST fatal_fault write while regwen set
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x0 with bit 0 and bit 31 set before regwen was cleared

points.title: Write 0 to regwen
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x0 with bit 31 equal 0

points.title: Alert test write after regwen cleared
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x0 with bit 0 set after regwen was cleared

points.title: Full-word Get of ALERT_TEST and CTRL
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word Get at 0x0 or 0x4

points.title: Full-word Get of interrupt, config, timer and compare registers
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word Get at an aligned offset in 0x100 to 0x11C

points.title: Interrupt output rises
points.condition: o_intr_timer_expired goes from 0 to 1

points.title: Interrupt output falls
points.condition: o_intr_timer_expired goes from 1 to 0

points.title: INTR_STATE W1C write while interrupt is high
points.condition: Accepted clean write to 0x104 with mask bit 0 and data bit 0 set while o_intr_timer_expired=1

points.title: INTR_TEST write of 1
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x108 with data bit 0 set

points.title: Compare write while timer active
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x118 or 0x11C while CTRL.active_0 is 1

points.title: Timer activated
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x4 with bit 0 set while inactive

points.title: Timer deactivated while active
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x4 with bit 0 clear while active

points.title: CFG0 written with nonzero prescale
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write to 0x10C with prescale field nonzero

points.title: TIMER_V_UPPER written to all ones
points.condition: Accepted clean full-word write of 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x114

points.title: A-channel stall of 3 or more cycles
points.condition: i_a_valid high and o_a_ready low after at least 2 earlier stalled cycles

points.title: D-channel back-pressure of 3 or more cycles
points.condition: o_d_valid high and i_d_ready low after at least 2 earlier such cycles

points.title: Request accepted with another outstanding
points.condition: Request accepted while at least one earlier request has no D beat yet

points.title: Reset released after activity
points.condition: First cycle after reset release when a request was pending, a response was valid or the timer was active before reset

points.title: Short reset window of at most 2 cycles
points.condition: First cycle after reset release following a reset low period of 1 or 2 cycles

points.title: Request at highest register-space word 0x1FC
points.condition: Accepted request to address 0x1FC
